authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt of India & State Welfare Depts
benefit: 100% compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursement + academic maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500/yr

criteria.label: Scheduled Caste (SC) community membership
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must belong to a recognized Scheduled Caste community verified by competent state revenue authority.
criteria.source_clause: Revised Guidelines for Post-Matric Scholarship to SC Students Clause III(i)
criteria.remediation: Upload a verified digital Caste Certificate issued by Tehsildar/SDM.

criteria.label: Annual family income threshold ceiling (<= ₹2,50,000 per annum)
criteria.plain_description: Total family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,50,000 per year.
criteria.source_clause: Revised Guidelines for Post-Matric Scholarship to SC Students Clause III(ii)
criteria.remediation: Provide current valid Income Certificate proving household income is under ₹2.5 Lakh/yr.

criteria.label: Enrollment in recognized post-matriculation educational course
criteria.plain_description: Student must be pursuing recognized post-secondary / higher secondary studies (Class 11, 12, Diploma, UG, or PG).
criteria.source_clause: Revised Guidelines for Post-Matric Scholarship to SC Students Clause IV
criteria.remediation: Upload latest marksheet, fee receipt, or college Bonafide Certificate.

criteria.label: Aadhaar seeded bank account for direct benefit transfer
criteria.plain_description: The student must have an Aadhaar-linked savings bank account for direct scholarship disbursal.
criteria.remediation: Upload Aadhaar card linked with student's bank account.

application.office_name: District Welfare Officer (Social Welfare) or College Nodal Officer
documents_to_carry: Original Income Certificate (issued within last 1 year)
Student Bank Passbook and Aadhaar Card
process_steps: Register on National Scholarship Portal (NSP) with One-Time Registration (OTR)
Upload digital certificates and select institution and course
Institution Nodal Officer (INO) verifies application online within 15 days
District Nodal Officer (DNO) verifies and sanctions scholarship directly to student's bank account via DBT
